items.title: 32.2 Medah mein pH ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stomach pH and drugs (PDF 234).

blocks.text: Medah (stomach) bohat tezabi hai, jis ka pH 1.5-3.5 jitna kam hai. Yeh tezabiyat parietal cells qaboo karte hain, jo hydrogen ions (H+) ko medah mein pump karte hain; yeh tezab khana hazam karne aur bacteria marne mein madad deta hai. pH bohat kam hone ke bawajood medah mucus ki moti tah aur bicarbonate ions se apni hifazat karta hai, jo cells ki satah par tezab ko neutralise karte hain.

Medah ka kam pH ghair-makhsoos (non-specific) reactions kar sakta hai: yeh kuch dawaon ko kimiyai taur par badal sakta hai. Maslan kuch dawayein khoon mein jazb hone se pehle tezabi mahol mein toot jati hain. Isi liye kuch dawayein hifazati tah (coating) ke saath di jati hain jo sirf kam tezabi chhoti aant (small intestine) mein ghulti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: medah ka andar (pH 1.5-3.5, H+ ions), us ke neeche mucus + HCO3- ki tah ('neutralise acid'), aur sab se neeche deewar ke cells jin se do surkh teer H+ ko andar pump karte hain ('parietal cells pump H+'). Daen: coated goli medah mein saboot ('coating intact'), phir small intestine mein coating ghul jati hai ('coating dissolves').
blocks.caption: Medah ki tezabiyat aur coated goliyan (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Medah apni deewar ko apne tezab se kaise bachata hai?
blocks.explanation: Mucus ki moti tah aur bicarbonate ions se, jo cells ki satah par tezab neutralise karte hain.

items: Medah ka pH 1.5-3.5; parietal cells H+ pump karte.
Tezab dawayein tor sakta: coated goliyan aant mein ghulti.
